package.name: strands-google
package.source: PyPI (sdist verified byte-identical to supplied flattened source)
package.module_version_attr_quirk: strands_google.__version__ reports '0.1.0' in the 0.2.0 release (stale upstream literal)

exports.name: use_google
exports.hot_load: standalone module file loads via strands.tools.loader.load_tools_from_file_path (google libs are lazy imports)

exports.name: gmail_send
exports.hot_load: module file loads via load_tools_from_file_path; requires strands_google package importable (intra-package import of use_google)

shared_dependencies_for_parent.note: Add to orchestrator/requirements.txt for the shared orchestrator/.venv. strands-agents==1.50.2 already satisfied; strands-mcp-server is a hard metadata dep of strands-google (pulls mcp server + boto3 stack).

environment_variables.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: Path to a service-account JSON key (server-to-server)
environment_variables.GOOGLE_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS: Path to an authorized-user OAuth token JSON produced by google_auth
environment_variables.GOOGLE_API_KEY: API key for public/no-user-data APIs (e.g. YouTube search, Places)
environment_variables.GOOGLE_API_SCOPES: Optional comma-separated OAuth scope override; default is a read-only set
environment_variables.BYPASS_TOOL_CONSENT: Set 'true' to skip the interactive y/N prompt on mutative methods (required for non-TTY worker execution)

safety.mutative_guard: use_google prompts for confirmation on create/insert/update/patch/delete/trash/remove/send/stop/cancel/modify unless BYPASS_TOOL_CONSENT=true
safety.default_scopes: read-only (gmail.readonly, drive.readonly, calendar.readonly, youtube.readonly, userinfo, cloud-platform)
